plugins.name: sweeps
plugins.description: Two paired repository sweeps with opposite calibrations: truing finds what a repo says that is not so, parsimony proposes what should stop existing.

plugins.name: noun
plugins.description: The Noun Project icon API, as one skill: sign a request with the keys in the environment, search and fetch icons, download them in a colour, and mind the quota and the attribution.

plugins.name: writing-shop
plugins.description: An editorial shop for prose an agent writes to a person: an anchored head-writer voice, advisors who argue by letter, a fact check against the world, a mechanical gate; and serial, the part-by-part delivery that lets the reader stop and ask.
